_comment: The SIT seed's catalog (docs/sit-seed.md), read by SeedData. The seed features name each booking by composition and product ID. itradeableTypes: the Excel's full Itradeable Type (column E) of each composition the seed books, one to one ({"<composition>": "<Itradeable Type>"}). trades: a list of {composition, productId, taxonomy, dat, setup} for a pair (or a pair with one taxonomy) whose dat file name or body is not the default (a registered composition's dat is data/dat/<C>/<C>.dat, any other's seed/dat/<C>/<productId>.dat; the body is data/setup/trade-create). cases: by seed case ID, {request, dat, setup} for that case alone, over trades; request is merged over the setup body (the portfolio and entity of the case). variants: another body for a pair, by name. events: the E2E Outline whose positive case's request books the event, via trigger-event (the default) or update (the amendment).

cases._comment: Per seed case: request (fields merged over the setup body: basic.portfolioId, basic.scbEntity), dat, setup. Real SIT values on the company copy only.
